description: Check up to 10 businesses you found elsewhere (maps, web, a link) before you give your user a phone or send them somewhere: open or closed with dated evidence, the phone its sources agree on, how to act. To look up a business your user names, send its name and town alone; a phone, website or address as well makes the match surer. With the need, you also get two listed businesses that fit it that you did not send. One not found is reported as not in Truvon.
